outcome: composite neonatal respiratory morbidity (respiratory distress syndrome, mechanical ventilation, surfactant administration, transferred with respiratory complications, neonatal death)
cohort: The study population consisted of 277 individuals with twin pregnancies at risk for early preterm birth (24+0 to 33+6 weeks of gestation) in a university-affiliated hospital in China from 2013 to 2020.
finding: No significant association was observed between antenatal corticosteroids administration during the early-preterm period in twin pregnancies and a decreased risk of newborn morbidity.
mod_finding: No significant interaction was found for mode of delivery in relation to the primary neonatal outcome.
gest_age: 24+0 to 33+6 weeks of gestation (at risk for early preterm birth)
